frame:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game architecture sprite.
Reference image is the approved north departure checkpoint concept. Extract/re-create ONLY the permanent gate facade: two short sentry cabins with dark blue-grey corrugated roofs, small windows, two cream weathered rectangular gate pillars with amber lights, left CCTV and right loudspeaker, the narrow overhead crossbar and cream enamel sign reading exactly "出入口". A wide EMPTY transparent aperture between pillars. NO gate leaves, NO ground/floor, NO people, NO plants, NO neighboring buildings.
Same orthographic top-down with visible north-facing front facade as the reference, handpainted muted prison/factory game, black ink outlines, cream stone, desaturated blue steel, modest wear. Straight horizontal front, no isometric slant.
Composition landscape sprite centered, entire assembly visible, transparent background. Pillars inner faces at approximately 23% and 77% of full sprite width; cabins outside pillars. Approximate aspect ratio width:height 2.6:1. Sign sits on header above the completely transparent aperture. No white matte, no cast shadow across the aperture. All space inside and below the arch must be genuinely transparent. No huge tower or unnecessary additions.
closed: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent 2D game sprite, ONLY the CLOSED two-leaf metal bar gate from the reference departure checkpoint. No pillars, cabins, signage, ground, people, other props. Two symmetrical rectangular iron-bar leaves span full width, meet at central latch. Blue grey thick vertical iron bars, rivets, horizontal rails, small rust, black painted outlines, slight cream highlights. Orthographic top-down game frontage exactly aligned horizontally like reference, not isometric; visible front facade. Left and right outer hinge rails upright. Entire sprite visible, no cropping. Wide rectangle approx width:height 2:1. Genuine transparent background INCLUDING all spaces between bars. Retain bars geometry readable at small game scale. No outer surrounding frame/post/arch.
open: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent 2D game sprite, ONLY two OPEN hinged blue-grey iron-bar gate leaves from the approved concept. Supporting second image is the closed gate; match its three horizontal rails, thick vertical bars, central latch, wear, bolts, colors and iron material. No surrounding arch, sign, pillars, cabins, ground, people. Two symmetrical gate leaves rotated inward about 70 degrees: left hinge at far-left edge, left free tip projects diagonally toward lower-right by about one quarter of total aperture width; right hinge far-right and tip projects down-left same amount. Full large EMPTY TRANSPARENT central corridor between free tips. Camera same north-front/top-down orthographic game view as the concept. Upright hinge side rails, straight geometry, black handpainted outlines. Original aperture width:whole projected height approx 2:1, transparent rectangular canvas. All slots between bars transparent. Render paired leaves as one aligned sprite, visible entirety, no floor/shadows. The leaves should be noticeably narrow in projected screen width, nearly folded toward the sides, leaving middle 65% clear.
desk: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type transparent 2D handpainted prison factory game prop. Recreate ONLY the small right-side document inspection desk assembly from approved reference: one worn brown wooden desk viewed from same slightly top-down orthographic north-front game angle, tidy white paper/register stack and clipboard on tabletop, one small black stamp/inkpad. Two modest olive-brown metal chairs behind desk. Cream enamel plate on front reads exactly "外出检查". Desk width approximately 1.6 times full assembly height. Muted worn warm brown wood and dark metal, black outlines, readable simplified details consistent with concept. Whole sprite centered, genuine transparent background, no ground, no people, no gate, no booth, no environment, no barrier. Simple compact desk, not huge reception office counter.
barrier: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type transparent 2D game prop. One simple portable metal crowd control barrier from the approved checkpoint concept, front/top-down orthographic north-facing viewpoint, straight horizontal rail. Dull grey-blue steel, two slim vertical end supports with splayed rounded feet, rectangular waist-high frame, four vertical inner bars, small bolts and rust, dark handpainted outline. Thin light utilitarian frame, width roughly 2.3 times height. Match the prison factory game reference's muted illustrated sprite art. Whole standalone sprite visible on genuinely transparent background, no ground, no desk, no people, no text or signs, no heavy stone pillars.
